workflowNarrative:
The Category Sorter runs first, grouping the month's transactions into categories the household actually recognises, keeping those categories stable across months, and reconciling the totals so everything downstream can be trusted.

The Change Spotter then compares against a rolling window of previous months, reporting movements in both absolute and proportional terms, separating a one-month spike from a step change, and listing the recurring charges with how long each has been running and whether its price has moved.

The Review Lead assembles the month into a one-page summary and a list of questions worth a human decision. The boundary is the point of this team: it never moves money, opens an account, recommends a product, or offers financial advice. It reports, and the household decides.
